## Editor.insertBefore() method

Queues inserting `text` immediately before the node's first character, leaving the node itself untouched.

**Signature:**

```typescript
insertBefore(node: Node, text: string): void;
```

## Exceptions

[ForeignNodeError](./sh-codemod.foreignnodeerror.md) when `node` is not from this editor's parse.

[InvalidNodeError](./sh-codemod.invalidnodeerror.md) when `node` is not a syntax node.

RangeError with `SH_CODEMOD_EDIT_RANGE` when parser bounds do not name character boundaries.
